nonblocking: The walkthrough link now appears in the topbar session-actions div alongside Save project. On narrow viewports the session-actions row already contains a save-state span, an Open project label, a Save project button, and the walkthrough link — confirm CSS flex-wrap or overflow handling keeps this row within 390px without horizontal scroll. The e2e test at 390px only checks /walkthrough, not the studio root, so a potential studio overflow at phone width is not covered by existing tests.

The restore() function introduces a local parameter named 'id' (the savedId helper arrow) that shadows the outer 'id' parameter (opRef counter). This is functionally safe because savedId only receives s.fgId/s.bgId and the outer id is not read after the helper is defined, but the shadowing could confuse future maintainers. Consider renaming the helper parameter to 'saved' or 'rawId'.

The session autosave useEffect dependency array now includes fgId and bgId. This means every palette dropdown change triggers a 600ms debounced saveLocal call. This is correct behavior but slightly increases IndexedDB write frequency during rapid palette toggling. The debounce mitigates this adequately.
